run_experiment: run a BenchMARL multi-agent RL experiment with MAPPO algorithm on the VMAS BALANCE task
configure_mlp_model: configure an MLP model with Linear layers, 32 neurons per layer, and ReLU activation
load_config_from_yaml: load BenchMARL experiment, algorithm, and model configurations from YAML files using get_from_yaml
create_experiment: create an Experiment instance with a VMAS task, MAPPO algorithm config, and MLP model config
set_model_layers: set the MLP model layer class, number of cells, and activation class for the agent policy network
